Hi, I need some help with a few returns and exchanges from my recent order. I’m not sure if this is going to work out, but I’d like to try. I want to return my luggage set and get the same one but in red, and also return my skateboard for a new one that’s 34 inches and has a custom design. I also want to return my hiking boots. For the pending order modification, I’d like to use my credit card. I hope this isn’t too complicated…

Happy to help—though I’ll need to authenticate you first and then we can look up the order status(s) and item details.

1) **Please share your email address** (preferred), so I can locate your user account.
2) Also, please tell me your **order id(s)** (e.g., `#W0000000`) for the luggage set, skateboard, and hiking boots.
3) For the **refunds for the returns** (luggage set + hiking boots): do you want the refund to go to your **credit card** (same one) or a **gift card**?
4) For the **pending order modification** you mentioned: confirm which order id that applies to (and whether “use my credit card” is the one you want to pay/receive any price difference for).

Once I have your email + order id(s), I’ll check which items are **delivered** vs **pending** and then I’ll ask for your **explicit “yes” confirmation** before submitting any return/exchange/modification.

Oh, I actually can’t remember my email address right now… I’m sorry, I know that’s not helpful. But my name is Liam Thomas and my zip code is 85049—maybe that can help you find my account? 

I’m not sure about the order IDs either, I just know it’s my most recent order with the luggage set, skateboard, and hiking boots. I’d like any refunds to go back to my credit card, please. And yes, for the pending order modification, I want to use my credit card for any price difference.

Sorry if this is making things difficult. Is there any way you can look up my order with just my name and zip code?
liam_thomas_7882
